title: Upgraded 1-Bedroom Duplex, Lake View
subtitle: High Floor | Lake View | Fully Furnished
location: Jumeirah Bay X1, Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT), Dubai
description: Nova Casa Real Estate is pleased to present this stunning upgraded 1-bedroom duplex apartment in Jumeirah Bay X1, JLT.
Spanning 977.58 sq. ft., this beautifully designed residence offers a spacious duplex layout, contemporary interiors and breathtaking views of the JLT lake from a high-floor position.

The apartment has been fully upgraded and furnished, featuring modern finishes and a stylish interior that is ready for immediate occupancy. The duplex configuration creates a natural separation between the living and private areas, providing both functionality and a generous sense of space.
With its prime location, attractive layout and fully furnished condition, this property is an excellent choice for both end users and investors looking for a distinctive residence in JLT.
